title: Urtica dioica essential oil for medicinal use
intro: Urtica dioica essential oil is a concentrated extract derived from the stinging nettle plant, known for its potent medicinal properties. It is obtained through steam distillation of the fresh leaves and stems of the plant, capturing its active compounds. In herbalism, this oil is used topically to reduce inflammation and alleviate skin conditions due to its anti-inflammatory and astringent effects. It is also employed in aromatherapy to support respiratory health and ease muscle pain. However, it should be diluted before use as it can be irritating to the skin.
